items.title: 9.1 Introduction to Design Thinking and Business Solutions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.1 (PDF 208), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum entrepreneurship (apna karobar shuru karna aur chalana) ki aham baatein parhenge, yaani woh skills (hunar) aur strategies (kaam ke soche samjhe tareeqe) jo karobar ki kamyabi ke liye zaroori hain. Chapter innovation (nayi soch se behtari), creativity (naye ideas sochne ki salahiyat) aur problem-solving (masle ka hal) ki ahmiyat batata hai, aur Design Thinking ko aisa tareeqa batata hai jo human-centered (insan ki zaroorat ko sab se aage rakhne wala) tareeqe se achhe business solutions banata hai. Phir yeh business plan banana, market insights (bazaar ki maloomat) jama karna aur investors (paisa lagane walon) ke saamne apna idea pitch karna (pesh karna) sikhata hai. Is ke ilawa marketing aur sales ki strategies, financial concepts (paise se juri bunyadi baatein), aur communication (baat cheet), collaboration (mil kar kaam) aur iteration (baar baar behtar karna) ki ahmiyat bhi batata hai. Aakhir mein yeh dikhata hai ke innovation aur creativity naye hal nikalne aur pehle se maujood products aur services ko behtar banane mein kya role (kirdar) ada karti hain.
Aayiye dekhein ke Design Thinking jaise creative tareeqe karobaron ko mushkilat ka saamna karne aur customers (gahakon) ki zarooratein behtar tareeqe se poori karne mein kaise madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurship ki apne alfaaz mein definition (matlab) likhiye (short question 1). Entrepreneurship ka asal maqsad (main goal) kya hai (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Entrepreneurship ka matlab hai kisi masle ya mauqe ko pehchanna, kuch risk (khatra) utha kar aisa karobar shuru karna jo us masle ko hal kare, aur log is hal ke liye paise dene ko tayyar hon. MCQ 1: (b) masle hal karna aur value (qadr) paida karna. Chapter is lafz ki seedhi definition nahi deta; yeh definition aam maloomat se hai.

items: Entrepreneurship: karobar ke zariye masle hal karna aur value (qadr) paida karna.
Chapter ke hisse: Design Thinking, business plan, market insights, pitch, marketing aur sales, financial concepts, communication, collaboration, iteration, innovation aur creativity.
